comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left is 1 if any comment explicitly engages (critically or not, including accepting or building on) a specific OP-cited example or premise, and generic replies don't count. Right is 1 if any comment directly challenges the OP's view with well-reasoned, coherent counterargument, and pure agreement doesn't count. Left needs no reasoning quality or opposition. Right needs no tie to a specific cited example. The null rules also differ: left is null if argument is missing, right only if both title and argument are missing.
